name: Whispering Mind
source: Whispering Mind is a psychological horror visual novel in development that explores themes such as mental health, isolation, and the consequences of our choices. Follow the story of a high school student whose life takes a dark turn after befriending Melissa, uncovering a mystery hidden behind the normality of everyday life.
